pynvvideocodec.rationale: PyNvVideoCodec is an MIT-licensed NVIDIA package; OSRB approved calling it (NVBug 6208455 #4, #5). Its NVIDIA-published wheel ships portions of FFmpeg under the GNU LGPL (NOTICES.txt); ovannotators depends on that wheel and does not redistribute FFmpeg (#7).
